name: visiontec
description: Visiontec Systems website: Strapi CMS (cms/) + Next.js frontend (web/)

scripts.postinstall: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm install --prefix cms && npm install --prefix web --ignore-scripts
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n cms,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run develop --prefix cms" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix cms && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n cms,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start --prefix cms" "npm run start --prefix web"
scripts.reset-content: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('cms/.tmp',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').rmSync('cms/public/uploads',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').mkdirSync('cms/public/uploads',{recursive:true});console.log('Content reset. Run npm run dev to re-import.')"
